correctness.rationale: The proof uses a triangle with edge vectors u,v: compare interior z=hU+kV with 0 and an adjacent vertex to obtain d_p(z,vertices)<= (||U||+||V||)/2. By convexity and Hanner for p>=2, triangle deficiency^p <=2^(-p-1)[(||u||+||v||)^p+|||u||-||v|||^p]. Applying Meyer Lemma 2.4 when z is outside trivial A+conv B or conv A+B regions gives a parallelogram whose side lengths are <=2a,2b; F_p(x,y) monotone yields upper envelope. Sharp diagonal-antidiagonal vectors u=(2^(1-1/p)a,2^(1-1/p)a), v=(2^(1-1/p)b,-2^(1-1/p)b) make four vertices equidistant from midpoint, exactly attaining F_p(a,b). Imported lemma checked in primary source.
